segments.text: Lord, I come with nothing to offer you, In my hands the gifts I bring,
All I have is my pride and my selfishness, All I want is you as my king,
In my weakness now I come more, Be my strength and be my song.
Give my need, I seek your help more I am weak but you are strong
Give me strength, dear Lord, to obey Your word, as I take the shield of faith.
I receive your gift of salvation, I rejoice in the gift of your grace.
In my weakness now I come more, In my shape and in my smile,
In my need I seek Your help, Lord I am weak but You are strong
In my dreams and now I come home In my shed and in my song
In my name I take your help, Lord.
I am weak but you are strong
Lord, I come with nothing to appear.
In my hands the gifts are green.
All I have is my pride and my selfishness.
All I want is you as my king.
In my weakness now I come more, Be my strength and be my song.
